name: Wikisource (français)
legal: Bibliothèque libre de la Wikimedia Foundation : textes du domaine public ou sous licence libre, exportés en EPUB par l'outil officiel WS Export.
notes: The official WS Export tool publishes one OPDS file per wiki category: fr/Bon_pour_export.xml lists the works the French community marked ready for export (about 9 MB). Harvested weekly. check_download is off because each EPUB is generated on demand (slow, ~30 s) and we must not load WS Export for a health check.
